# ArtPlayer 5.4.0

Vendored from https://registry.npmjs.org/artplayer/-/artplayer-5.4.0.tgz.
The tarball SHA-512 integrity was checked against npm version metadata before copying.
Files: dist/artplayer.js and dist/i18n/zh-tw.js. MIT license is included.

The player injects its own CSS. No advertising, casting, analytics, or other plugins are bundled here.
